Class LevelTower

java.lang.Object
models.game.LevelTower
public class LevelTower extends Object
Manages the state and progression of a procedural combat tower.

Tracks the player's current floor (2–10) and step within that floor (0–5). Each floor follows a fixed pattern of 6 steps: Combat, Reward, Combat, Combat, Reward, Boss. The tower is complete once the player advances past floor 10.
